body: {"prefix":"time","name":"Time Ontology in OWL","description":"Owl-time is an owl-2 dl ontology of temporal concepts, for describing the temporal properties of resources in the world or described in web pages. the ontology provides a vocabulary for expressing facts about topological (ordering) relations among instants and intervals, together with information about durations, and about temporal position including date-time information. time positions and durations may be expressed using either the conventional (gregorian) calendar and clock, or using another temporal reference system such as unix-time, geologic time, or different calendars.","uri_format":"http://www.w3.org/2006/time#$1","providers":[{"code":"2022","name":"2022 Draft","homepage":"https://www.w3.org/TR/owl-time/","uri_format":"https://www.w3.org/TR/owl-time/#time:$1"}],"homepage":"https://www.w3.org/TR/owl-time","repository":"https://github.com/w3c/sdw","contact":{"name":"Simon Cox","orcid":"0000-0002-3884-3420","email":"dr.shorthair@pm.me","github":"dr-shorthair"},"example":"DateTimeDescription","example_extras":[],"license":"CC-BY-4.0","version":"2017","download_owl":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c/sdw/gh-pages/time/rdf/time.ttl","download_rdf":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/w3c/sdw-time/refs/heads/gh-pages/rdf/time.ttl","deprecated":false,"mappings":{"aberowl":"TIME","bartoc":"18311","bioportal":"TIME","fairsharing":"FAIRsharing.hw3bh2","lov":"time","tib.ts":"time","zazuko":"time"},"synonyms":[],"keywords":["data coordination","ess","fair data spaces","metadata standardization","nfdi4chem","ontology","resource metadata","subject agnostic","time"],"publications":[],"appears_in":[],"depends_on":[],"namespace_in_lui":false,"contributor":{"name":"Charles Tapley Hoyt","orcid":"0000-0003-4423-4370","email":"cthoyt@gmail.com","github":"cthoyt"},"preferred_prefix":"time","github_request_issue":505}
